dev.reason: The API module and local entrypoints now consume the Workspace file-backed contract, but AviaAuth still exposes liveness only; OIDC/private-admin integration, the optional AviaData-disabled path, and cross-repository runtime checks remain unverified.

demo.reason: Keycloak-specific runtime paths and preprod-demo assumptions remain; AviaAuth integration, prepared users, persistent curated data, and immutable image release are not verified.

preprod.reason: Provider-neutral OIDC and private-admin integration, file-backed database/auth configuration, source-bound immutable images, and external deployment evidence remain incomplete.

prod.reason: Production OIDC/MFA, identity and data migration, immutable release artifacts, infrastructure/recovery ownership, rollback evidence, and deployment approval are not established.
